verdict.rationale: New Relic documents its own AI assistant for asking questions, troubleshooting and exploring telemetry in plain language, plus an MCP server that turns plain-English questions into NRQL. The evidence covers natural-language querying and analysis, not operating the product, such as creating alerts, dashboards or configuration changes by natural-language command. missing for 10: documented natural-language actions or configuration (e.g., creating alerts or dashboards via commands), independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's effectiveness

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.
If you're struggling to get a query to work, ask our AI assistant to help you.
